QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_23

question.text: If Saraswati Debt Fund has capital commitments of INR 800 crore out of which INR 600 crore has been called down from LPs, its PIC (Paid-In-Capital) multiple is:

explanation.text: The Logic: PIC Multiple = Paid-In Capital / Committed Capital = 600 / 800 = 0.75 or 75%. A high PIC indicates the fund is near the end of its drawdown phase. The Trap: Option B inverts the ratio. Option C is the undrawn fraction. Option A is not a meaningful PIC value. Note: The PIC multiple is defined in the fund performance chapter of the workbook.
